description: The Xither record for one vendor. Use it when the user names a specific vendor and asks where it publishes its sub-processor list or DPA, how long its terms give to object to a new sub-processor, what it has changed, or when its models retire. Returns: where it publishes its sub-processor list and data processing agreement and when Xither last read each page (or why a page cannot be read); the notice window its agreement states for new sub-processors (quoted, with source URL and read date); its public changes to either document with permalinks; and model retirement dates it publishes for the next 365 days. One vendor per call; accepts a name, slug or domain. If the name matches several vendors it returns their slugs to call again with; if it matches none, the vendor is not in the record, which says nothing about what the vendor publishes. Use search_vendors instead when you only have part of a name, notice_windows to compare windows across vendors, and upcoming_model_retirements for retirements across vendors. Changes appear 30 days after Xither records them; subscribers get them the same morning at www.xither.com/pricing.

vendor.description: A vendor name, slug or domain, for example "HubSpot", "hubspot" or "hubspot.com".
